title: Dictionaries, Textual Studies, and Other Reference Works
content:
7.4 Dictionaries, Textual Studies, and Other Reference Works

Barthélemy, Dominique; A. R. Hulst; Norbert Lohfink; W. D. McHardy; H. P. Rüger; and James A. Sanders. 1973 1980. Preliminary and Interim Report on the Hebrew Old Testament Text Project. 5 volumes. New York: United Bible Societies. (Cited as HOTTP.)

Blenkinsopp, Joseph. 2002. Isaiah 40–55 (Anchor Bible, 19A). New York: Doubleday.

Bloch, Ariel, and Chana Bloch. 1995. The Song of Songs. New York: Random House.

Bratcher, Robert G., and Barclay M. Newman. 1983. A Handbook on The Book of Joshua. New York: United Bible Societies.

Bromiley, Geoffrey W., editor. 1979–1988. The International Standard Bible Encyclopedia. 4 volumes. Grand Rapids: Eerdmans.

Brown, Francis; S. R. Driver; and Charles A. Briggs, editors. 1907; revised edition, 1968. A Hebrew and English Lexicon of the Old Testa-ment. London: Oxford University Press. (Cited as BDB.)

Budd, Philip J. 1984. Numbers (Word Biblical Commentary, 5). Waco, Texas: Word Books.

Bush, Frederic. 1996. Ruth, Esther (Word Biblical Commentary, 9). Dallas, Texas: Word Books.

Buttrick, George Arthur, editor. 1962. The Interpreter’s Dictionary of the Bible. 4 volumes. Nashville: Abingdon Press.

Clark, David J., and Howard A. Hatton. 1989. A Handbook on The Books of Nahum, Habakkuk, and Zephaniah. New York: United Bible Societies.

De Vries, Simon J. 1985. 1 Kings (Word Biblical Commentary, 12). Waco, Texas: Word Books.

Dhorme, E. 1984. A Commentary on the Book of Job. Trans-lated by Harold Knight. Nashville, Camden, and New York: Thomas Nelson Publishers.

Durham, John I. 1987. Exodus (Word Biblical Commentary, 3). Nashville: Waco, Texas: Word Books.

du Toit, J. S., and J. A. Naudé. 2005. “Lost in Translation: Designation, Identification and Classification of Flora in Translated Biblical Texts.” Journal of Northwest Semitic Languages 32:33 58.

Eisemann, Moshe. 1994. Iyov/Job: A New Translation with a Commentary Anthologized from Talmudic, Midrashic and Rabbinic Sources. Brooklyn, New York: ArtScroll Mesorah Publications.

Fauna and Flora of the Bible. 1972; 2nd edition, 1980. New York: United Bible Societies. (Cited as FFB.)

Freedman, David Noel, editor. 1992. The Anchor Bible Dictionary. 6 volumes. New York: Doubleday. (Cited as ABD.)

Guillaume, A. 1968. Studies in the Book of Job with a New Translation. Edited by John MacDonald. Supplement II to the Annual of Leeds University Oriental Society. Leiden: E. J. Brill.

Herodotus. 1954. The Histories. Translated by Aubrey de Sélincourt. London: Penguin Books.

Hope, Edward R. 2005. All Creatures Great and Small: Living Things in the Bible. New York: United Bible Societies.

Janzen, J. G. 1973. Studies in the Text of Jeremiah. Cambridge: Harvard University Press.

Jones, Gwilym H., 1984. 1 and 2 Kings (New Century Bible Commentary). 2 volumes. Grand Rapids: Eerdmans.

Josephus. 1927. The Jewish War. Books III IV (Loeb Classical Library, 487). Translated by H. St. J. Thackeray. Cambridge, Massachu-setts: Harvard University Press.

Keil, C. F., and F. Delitzsch. 1872; reprinted 1975. Commentary on the Old Testament. 10 volumes. Grand Rapids: Eerdmans.

Koehler, Ludwig, and Walter Baumgartner, editors. 1958. Lexicon in Veteris Testamenti Libros. 2 volumes. Leiden: E. J. Brill; and Grand Rapids: Eerdmans.

Kuhn, Hanni. 1989. “Why Are Job’s Opponents Still Made to Eat Broom-Root?” The Bible Translator 40:332 336.

Liddell, Henry George, and Robert Scott. 9th edition, 1940. A Greek-English Lexicon. Revised and augmented by Henry Stuart Jones and others. Oxford: Clarendon Press.

Louw, Johannes P., and Eugene A. Nida. 2nd edition, 1989. Greek-English Lexicon of the New Testament based on Semantic Domains. 2 volumes. New York: United Bible Societies.

Lundbom, Jack R. 1999. Jeremiah 1–20 (Anchor Bible, 21A). New York: Doubleday.

McKane, William. 1986. A Critical and Exegetical Commentary on Jeremiah: Introduction and commentary on Jeremiah I–XXV. Edinburgh: T. & T. Clark.

Moscati, Sabatino. 1969. An Introduction to the Comparative Grammar of the Semitic Languages: Phonology and Morphology. Wiesbaden: Otto Harrassowitz.

Murphy, Roland E. 1990. The Song of Songs (Hermeneia). Minneapolis: Fortress Press.

Osborn, Noel D., and Howard A. Hatton. 1999. A Handbook on Exodus. New York: United Bible Societies.

Pliny the Elder. 1855. The Natural History. Translated and edited by John Bostock and H. T. Riley. London: Taylor and Francis.

Pope, Marvin H. 1965. Job (Anchor Bible, 15). Garden City, New York: Doubleday.

Pritz, Ray. 2009. The Works of Their Hands: Man-made Things in the Bible. New York: United Bible Societies. (Cited as WTH.)

Rabin, C.; S. Talmon; and E. Tov, editors. 1997. The Hebrew University Bible, The Book of Jeremiah. Jerusalem: Magnes Press.

Reyburn, William D. 1992. A Handbook on The Book of Job. New York: United Bible Societies.

Reyburn, William D., and Euan McG. Fry. 1998. A Handbook on Genesis. New York: United Bible Societies.

Robinson, Bernard P. 1985. “Jonah’s Qiqayon Plant.” Zeitschrift für die Alttestamentliche Wissenschaft. 97:390 403.

Snaith, Norman H. 1969. Leviticus and Number s (New Century Bible Commentary). Grand Rapids: Eerdmans.

Sperber, Alexander. 1959. The Aramaic Bible. Volume 2: The Former Prophets according to Targum Jonathan. Leiden: E. J. Brill.

Stevenson, Angus, and Christine A. Lindberg, editors. 3rd edition, 2010. New Oxford American Dictionary. New York: Oxford University Press.

Unger, Frederick Merrill. 1986. Unger’s Bible Dictionary. Chicago: Moody Press.

Wolfers, David. 1995. Deep Things out of Darkness: The Book of Job. Grand Rapids: Eerdmans.
